name: Sweety Girls
source:
Sweety Girls is an erotic visual novel in which you have to meet three enchanting beauties. Learn recipes for delicious desserts and choose the one you want to spend an evening alone with. Cook, seduce the girls and have fun!

In this game you become a young student who gets dumped by his girlfriend. You are invited to a cooking class to take your mind off your recent break-up. Will you be able to forget about your ex-girlfriend? Or maybe even find a new girlfriend? It's all up to you!
[From [URL=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2477310/]Steam[/URL]]
translation:
《Sweety Girls》是一部色情视觉小说，你必须在其中遇到三位迷人的美女。了解美味甜点的食谱，并选择你想与之共度一晚的甜点。做饭，勾引女孩，玩得开心！

在这款游戏中，你将扮演一名被女友抛弃的年轻学生。你被邀请参加烹饪班，以摆脱最近的分手的困扰。你能忘记你的前女友吗？或者甚至可以找到一个新女朋友？这一切都取决于你！
[来自 [URL=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2477310/]Steam[/URL]]
